`sql` only labels the fence; Streamdown needs its optional Shiki plugin to color it. `controls={{ code: false }}` only hides controls.

Install `@streamdown/code`, add its Tailwind source, then:

```tsx
import { code } from '@streamdown/code';

<Streamdown mode='static' controls={{ code: false }} plugins={{ code }}>
	{`\`\`\`sql\n${query}\n\`\`\``}
</Streamdown>
```

In `styles.css`:

```css
@source "../../../node_modules/@streamdown/code/dist/*.js";
```
